title: Shipping option
brief: Two selectable shipping rows at checkout. The chosen row has an orange border and radio dot, the row tints on hover, and the radio shows a ring on keyboard focus.

inspiration.note: Took the idea of radio choices with a supporting description line; ours are full-width cards with a price column.
Took the labelled radio with a filled dot and a visible focus ring; the orange palette and row layout are ours.
